app.name: anarlog
app.one_liner: The open-source AI meeting notetaker. Local-first. Privacy-first. Yours to fork.

screens.name: Main Meeting Notetaker
screens.purpose: Record, transcribe, and save meeting notes locally as Markdown files with user-chosen LLM summarization.

rust_commands.name: save_item
rust_commands.purpose: Persist a meeting note as a local Markdown file on disk.

mvp_plan: week 1: Implement local audio capture and on-device transcription
week 1: Save output as Markdown file to user-specified directory
acceptance_tests: LLM provider can be switched without app restart
Meeting notes are saved as .md files readable by any text editor
User can start/stop recording and see real-time transcription
